compare.hint: Same definitions for every vehicle; the month and the energy figures follow the reporting timezone and the vehicle's own TCO
compare.footnote: Cash paid covers energy, upkeep, insurance and financing, estimated energy included; full cost adds depreciation and amortized tires. Annual cost extrapolates the full cost over the observed history (three months minimum). Energy is charged energy at the plug. A vehicle under 60% completeness is shown but not ranked.
